messages:
sre-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: elevated 500s and model-mismatch errors for /v1/chat/stream. Affected customers: 3 enterprise projects. Error spike started ~1760164800. Routing fallback engaged to 'instruct-quant-v1' due to pin mismatch.

alex (oncall): seen it, paging raj and emma. I'm on it, will triage.

emma (infra): fyi I'm next oncall for infra - can you paste the router logs? I can tail routing decisions.

raj (serving): pulling logs now. quick summary: the smart-routing policy attempted to route to redwood-chat-v1 but pinned_model was set to redwood-instruct-v1 for team org-742, so fallback kicked in. The instruct variant is incompatible with chat protocol -> many requests returned validation errors.

alex (oncall): omg pinned_model? who changed that? 

liz (cs): customers started filing errors ~5m ago. I've told them we have a mitigation in progress. Need ETA to share.

emma (infra): commands I'm running:
```
# show latest routing decision for org-742
jq -r '.decisions[] | select(.org=="org-742")' /var/log/router/decisions.log | tail -n 40
```

raj (serving): output snippet:```
{ "org": "org-742", "requested_api": "/v1/chat/stream", "pinned_model": "redwood-instruct-v1", "selected_variant": "instruct-quant-v1", "fallback_reason": "pinned_incompatible_with_api" }
```

alex (oncall): that makes sense. So the pin points to an instruct model while the API path requires chat. Fix options: 1) Update pin to a chat-compatible model (redwood-chat-v1) 2) disable fallback routing for org-742 temporarily so we fail fast and surface to CS 3) Route org-742 to hosted default chat cluster.

emma (infra): I can put a temporary denylist on fallback rules for org-742: set policy.allow_fallback=false for that org in the control plane. That will reduce silent incorrect fallbacks.

raj (serving): prefer updating the pin to the intended chat model. Do we have recent pin changes in audit?

alex (oncall): checking audit: `/etc/controlplane/pins/audit.log` shows a change at 1760164700 by ops-runner: `ops-runner set pinned_model for org-742 to redwood-instruct-v1` with message "testing instr pipeline".

ops-runner: that was me — I ran a quick test earlier in staging but apparently applied the pin to prod by mistake. sorry.

alex (oncall): ok, mitigation plan: 1) rollback pin to previous value (redwood-chat-v0) 2) disable instruct-family fallback for org-742 3) route traffic to stable chat-only pool until we validate. Who can apply rollback now?

emma (infra): I can apply the disable fallback and route change now. Raj, can you make the pin rollback?

raj (serving): doing rollback now. Command:```
# rollback pin
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $CP_TOKEN" https://controlplane.api/pins/org-742 -d '{"pinned_model":"redwood-chat-v0"}'
```

raj (serving): response 200. New pin: redwood-chat-v0. Verifying router decisions...

emma (infra): applied policy change: `policy.allow_fallback=false` for org-742 and added temporary route rule to send chat API to chat-pool-1.

alex (oncall): monitoring metrics — errors dropping?

sre-bot: Metrics update (5m window): 500s for org-742 dropped from 18% -> 1.2%. Latency stable.

liz (cs): telling customers: "We identified a model pin misconfiguration that caused an incompatible variant to be selected. We've rolled back the pin and applied temporary routing to restore chat behavior. We'll follow up with root cause and remediation."

alex (oncall): good. Next steps: postmortem, fix deploy guardrails so pins can't be applied to prod without a flag, and add a routing policy validation that rejects pins whose variant families are incompatible with an org's active APIs. Raj / Emma can you add blockers?

raj (serving): I'll add a validator in the control plane: when pin change is requested, check the org's allowed api set (chat vs embeddings vs gen) and reject if mismatch unless `--force` is used. Also add an audit alert for pin changes that affects >1 customer.

emma (infra): I'll add a temporary automated rollback task in the pipeline that reverts pins if we detect immediate spike in error rates within 2 minutes. Also add a docs update for oncall runbook.

ops-runner: again, my mistake. I'll open PR for safer pin rollout scripts and a dev-only flag to prevent accidental prod application.

liz (cs): customers want ETA for full fix and postmortem. Can we commit to draft RC within 48h?

alex (oncall): yes. We'll prepare an incident writeup and RCA within 48 hours. For now, I'll mark this incident as mitigated and will hand off to the oncall postmortem bucket.

sre-bot: Incident status: MITIGATED. Incident created at 1760164800, mitigated at 1760166150. Link: <https://incidents.redwood.internal/1760164823>

alex (oncall): handoff: @emma you're owner for follow-ups (validation + rollback automation). @raj you'll own control plane validator work. Ops-runner to submit PRs for safer pinning. Liz to coordinate customer comms. I'll write initial incident summary and postmortem skeleton.

emma (infra): acknowledged. I'll update the runbook and drop a short blurb under /incidents/ for the postmortem.

raj (serving): leaving a note: add unit tests for pin compatibility check + integration test that simulates chat API requests while pinned to different model families.

liz (cs): thanks all. customers appreciate the quick mitigation.

alex (oncall): closing thread for active paging. Follow-ups tracked in #incidents-postmortem. :thumbsup:"
